answer: A slow trust glacier: identity weight grows only by years of unbroken honest attestations, and any detected sybil clique freezes the whole lineage. Each new agent chirps like a sparrow — tiny weight until a quorum of veterans echoes its signatures across epochs. An attacker must warm every fake identity through that long accumulation, paying time and coordination on each, so one echo of fraud collapses the entire investment while honest agents lose nothing.
